finding: Uses document.activeElement to find focused element across shadow DOM boundaries. Fails when focus is inside nested shadow roots.
suggestion: Replace document.activeElement with a utility that walks shadowRoot.activeElement recursively to find the deepest active element.

finding: Uses this.querySelectorAll to find child items from light DOM. Could match nested accordion items in deeply composed structures.
suggestion: Use slot.assignedElements({ flatten: true }) from a slotchange handler for more precise scoping.

finding: Uses document.activeElement in _moveFocus(). Fails when focus is inside a shadow root of a slotted custom element.
suggestion: Use recursive activeElement walk through shadowRoot boundaries, or composedPath() from a focusin event.

finding: String concatenation for class building instead of classMap directive. Inconsistent with rest of codebase.
suggestion: Use classMap() for all class construction in the template.

finding: Uses document.querySelector(this.returnFocusTo) to find focus return target. Only queries main document, not shadow DOMs.
suggestion: Document limitation or accept a direct element reference as alternative to CSS selector string.

finding: validSizes and validShapes arrays created on every willUpdate call. These are constant values.
suggestion: Move to static readonly class fields or module-level constants.

finding: validSizes and validShapes arrays duplicated in both willUpdate() and render(). Same validation computed twice.
suggestion: Compute sizeClass and shapeClass once in willUpdate() as @state properties, reference in render().

finding: New bound function references created in connectedCallback every time element is connected. If disconnected and reconnected, removeEventListener uses OLD bound reference while addEventListener creates NEW references. Old listeners never removed.
suggestion: Use arrow function class fields or bind once in constructor/field initializer, not in connectedCallback.

finding: JSON-LD script injection uses document.head.appendChild() creating global side-channel DOM mutation outside shadow DOM.
suggestion: Correctly guarded for SSR. Ensure cleanup in disconnectedCallback is always called.

finding: Initial values of _boundEllipsisClick and _boundEllipsisKeydown are no-op arrow functions immediately overwritten in connectedCallback. Wasted allocations.
suggestion: Initialize as null or bind in class field initializer directly.

finding: Missing formResetCallback and formStateRestoreCallback. Component declares formAssociated=true but only implements formDisabledCallback.
suggestion: Add formResetCallback() and formStateRestoreCallback() for complete form association.

finding: setFormValue only called inside _handleClick when type='submit', never in updated() when name/value properties change programmatically.
suggestion: Sync form value in updated() when name or value changes.

finding: Inline style binding uses string interpolation instead of styleMap directive. Bypasses Lit's efficient style diffing.
suggestion: Use styleMap directive: style=${styleMap({ transform: this._trackTransform })}

finding: Direct DOM style manipulation in drag handlers bypasses Lit's rendering and directly mutates shadow DOM styles.
suggestion: Use a @state property _isDragging to drive cursor styling via classMap or CSS :host selectors.

finding: Navigation buttons use inline arrow functions creating new function references on every render, preventing Lit's event listener caching.
suggestion: Use bound method references or arrow function class fields.

finding: Pagination dot buttons use inline arrow functions creating new closures on every render for each dot.
suggestion: Use event delegation on pagination container with data attributes.

finding: Inline arrow function in template creates new function reference on every render.
suggestion: Extract to a private arrow function class field for Lit event listener caching.

finding: Inline arrow function for @change creates new function reference on every render.
suggestion: Extract to a private arrow function class field.

finding: Error slot rendered in two different DOM locations depending on hasError state. Slot moving in DOM can cause unexpected slotchange events.
suggestion: Render error slot in single location, use ?hidden or display:none to toggle visibility.

finding: _getCheckboxes() uses this.children filtering by tagName. Only finds direct children, not wrapped hx-checkbox elements.
suggestion: Document that hx-checkbox must be direct children, or use querySelectorAll for deeper matching.

finding: Setting style property via this.style.setProperty in updated() and connectedCallback() is a side effect outside Lit rendering pipeline.
suggestion: Consider CSS host-context approach or :host([hx-size='sm']) attribute selectors.

finding: Inline style on aria-live span for visually-hidden text. Should use CSS class.
suggestion: Move visually-hidden styles to stylesheet as a .sr-only class.

finding: Multiple uses of shadowRoot.querySelector for grid, hue-slider, and opacity-slider parts instead of @query decorators.
suggestion: Replace with @query decorators for consistent shadow DOM access.

finding: _handlePanelKeydown uses shadowRoot.querySelector for trigger focus instead of @query.
suggestion: Add @query('[part="trigger"]') and use it instead.

finding: Explicit requestUpdate() calls after modifying _hsv via spread. Redundant since _hsv is @state().
suggestion: Remove explicit requestUpdate() calls.

finding: Swatch buttons use arrow function event handlers in map() loop creating new instances each render.
suggestion: Use single handler reading color from event target dataset, or accept as low-impact.

finding: connectedCallback adds document.addEventListener without SSR guard. In SSR environments, document is not available.
suggestion: Wrap in: if (typeof document !== 'undefined') { document.addEventListener(...); }

finding: disconnectedCallback calls document.removeEventListener without SSR guard.
suggestion: Wrap in: if (typeof document !== 'undefined') { document.removeEventListener(...); }

finding: Outside click handler could accumulate duplicate listeners if connectedCallback called multiple times without corresponding disconnectedCallback.
suggestion: Add guard to remove listener before adding, or track registration state.

finding: Hidden option slot uses inline style="display:none;" instead of CSS class.
suggestion: Move display:none to styles file using a class selector.

finding: Uses shadowRoot.querySelector for option slot instead of @query decorator.
suggestion: Add @query('slot[name="option"]') decorator.

finding: _copyToClipboard accesses navigator.clipboard without SSR guard.
suggestion: Add guard: if (typeof navigator === 'undefined' || !navigator.clipboard) return;

finding: connectedCallback creates matchMedia query but no change listener for prefers-reduced-motion. Runtime preference changes won't update animation behavior.
suggestion: Add MediaQueryList change listener in connectedCallback, remove in disconnectedCallback.

finding: Parameter named 'changedProps' inconsistent with project convention of 'changedProperties'.
suggestion: Rename to 'changedProperties' for consistency.

finding: willUpdate does not call super.willUpdate(). Project convention requires always calling super for lifecycle methods.
suggestion: Add super.willUpdate(changed) at beginning of method.

finding: Column header uses inline style for width instead of styleMap directive.
suggestion: Use styleMap: style=${styleMap(col.width ? { width: col.width } : {})}

finding: Skeleton row uses inline style instead of CSS class.
suggestion: Move to stylesheet as .skeleton-cell--checkbox class.

finding: Bound handlers recreated on every connectedCallback via .bind(this), producing new function references. On disconnect/reconnect, removeEventListener uses old reference but addEventListener creates new one. Listeners leak on reconnection cycles.
suggestion: Create bound references once in constructor, not in connectedCallback.

finding: Bound handler references initialized as no-op arrow functions then reassigned in connectedCallback. Initial arrows wasted.
suggestion: Move .bind(this) calls to constructor so they run once.

finding: _hasLabelSlot and _hasErrorSlot are plain private fields with manual requestUpdate() instead of @state().
suggestion: Decorate with @state() and remove explicit requestUpdate() calls.

finding: _viewYear and _viewMonth initialized with new Date() at class field level. In SSR, creates Date based on server time causing hydration mismatch.
suggestion: Initialize to safe default and set actual date in connectedCallback.

finding: _openDialog accesses document.activeElement without SSR guard.
suggestion: Wrap in: if (typeof document !== 'undefined') { ... }

finding: render() builds class strings manually with string concatenation instead of classMap.
suggestion: Use classMap({ divider: true, 'divider--labeled': showLabel })

finding: aria-orientation and aria-label use template literal interpolation with nothing. Should use non-interpolated binding for correct nothing behavior.
suggestion: Use aria-orientation=${isDecorative ? nothing : this.orientation} without quotes.

finding: _openDrawer accesses document.activeElement without SSR guard.
suggestion: Wrap in: if (typeof document !== 'undefined') { ... }

finding: _hideBackgroundFromScreenReaders accesses document.body.children without SSR guard.
suggestion: Add: if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;

finding: _getAnimationDuration accesses window.matchMedia without SSR guard.
suggestion: Add: if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 0;

finding: header-actions slot uses inline style="display:none" when _hasHeaderActionsSlot is false.
suggestion: Use ?hidden attribute binding or CSS class instead.

finding: updated() does not call super.updated(). Missing super call breaks lifecycle chains for mixins.
suggestion: Add super.updated(changedProperties) at beginning of method.

finding: _updatePosition uses Object.assign(panel.style, ...) for direct DOM manipulation outside Lit rendering lifecycle.
suggestion: Use styleMap directive or accept as necessary for floating-ui integration.

finding: If _show() called multiple times without _hide(), multiple outside-click listeners could accumulate.
suggestion: Add guard in _show() to avoid adding duplicate listeners.

finding: _setupTriggerAria and updated() both use shadowRoot.querySelector to find trigger slot. Duplicated query.
suggestion: Add @query('slot[name="trigger"]') and reuse across methods.

finding: Inline style applied via span.style.cssText for visually-hidden a11y description element. Bypasses Lit template system.
suggestion: Use a CSS class (.visually-hidden or .sr-only) from stylesheet instead.

finding: this.appendChild(span) directly manipulates light DOM children outside Lit's template system.
suggestion: Documented as intentional. Ensure tests verify cleanup in disconnectedCallback.

finding: Uses raw querySelector on shadowRoot instead of @query decorator in _handleDragLeave.
suggestion: Replace with @query('.dropzone') decorator.

finding: updated() casts changedProperties to Map<PropertyKey, unknown> to check private _files state. Fragile workaround for TypeScript PropertyValues typing.
suggestion: Use changedProperties.has('_files' as keyof this) or use willUpdate for derived state sync.

finding: Inline style string interpolation for --_progress-ratio instead of styleMap directive.
suggestion: Use styleMap({'--_progress-ratio': String(entry.progress / 100)})

finding: repeat() key function uses entry.file.name + entry.file.size which is not guaranteed unique. Two files with same name and size would collide.
suggestion: Add entry.file.lastModified to the key for uniqueness.

finding: AdoptedStylesheetsController instantiated with document as class field initializer. Document global accessed at construction time throws in SSR.
suggestion: Defer document reference to connectedCallback or guard with typeof document check.

finding: _getLocale() accesses document.documentElement.lang and navigator.language unconditionally. Browser-only APIs crash in SSR.
suggestion: Guard with typeof document/navigator checks, fall back to 'en' in SSR.

finding: Static caches _dtfCache and _rtfCache are Maps that grow without bound. Could accumulate in long-running healthcare apps.
suggestion: Consider LRU eviction or max size. Acceptable for typical usage with small number of combinations.

finding: HelixGridItem.updated() does not call super.updated(). Skips LitElement's base lifecycle.
suggestion: Add super.updated(changed) as first line of updated().

finding: HelixGridItem._applyHostGridStyles() directly manipulates this.style.gridColumn/gridRow. Imperative DOM manipulation outside Lit template.
suggestion: Defensible since grid-column/grid-row must be on host. Consider styleMap pattern if refactoring.

finding: updated() does not call super.updated(). Skips LitElement's base lifecycle hook.
suggestion: Add super.updated(changed) as first line.

finding: _sanitizeSvg() uses new DOMParser() which is browser-only. Throws in SSR.
suggestion: Guard with typeof DOMParser !== 'undefined'.

finding: Module-level _svgCache Map grows without bound. In long-running SPA with dynamic icon URLs, never releases memory.
suggestion: Add LRU eviction or max cache size.

finding: formAssociated is true and name/value exist, but setFormValue() is never called. Form won't include button's name/value in FormData.
suggestion: Sync form value via updated() when value or name changes.

finding: When src changes, _error and _usedFallbackSrc states not reset. Component remains in error state after src change.
suggestion: Add willUpdate handler that resets _error and _usedFallbackSrc when src changes.

finding: _updateItemStates() uses this.querySelectorAll to imperatively set properties on children. Tight coupling.
suggestion: Consider context protocol or CSS custom properties for parent-child communication.

finding: _handleKeydown uses this.querySelector('hx-list-item:focus'). :focus may not match if focus is inside item's shadow DOM.
suggestion: Use document.activeElement with composed path or :focus-within for reliable detection.

finding: _updateFocusedIndex accesses document.activeElement directly. Won't find correct active element when focus is inside shadow DOM.
suggestion: Use shadowRoot.activeElement or traverse composed path.

finding: updated() does not call super.updated(). Missing super call can break mixin or base class lifecycle chains.
suggestion: Add super.updated() as first line.

finding: updated() directly manipulates host element style via this.style.setProperty and this.dataset. Side effects outside render template.
suggestion: Move to willUpdate() or use styleMap in template.

finding: _handleKeydown uses shadowRoot.querySelectorAll instead of @query decorator.
suggestion: Use @queryAll decorator or cache query result.

finding: Multiple raw querySelector calls in _handleKeydown and _handleSubKeydown for focus management.
suggestion: Use @query decorators for frequently accessed elements.

finding: Submenu children rendered with Array.map instead of repeat directive. Labels could serve as stable keys.
suggestion: Use repeat(children, (child) => child.label, ...) for keyed rendering.

finding: repeat() uses index as key, defeating purpose of repeat() for stable identity.
suggestion: Use stable key like item.href ?? item.label.

finding: _sanitizeHref references window.location.href, not available during SSR.
suggestion: Guard with typeof window check or try/catch with fallback.

finding: firstUpdated() does not call super.firstUpdated().
suggestion: Add super.firstUpdated() for future-proofing.

finding: Long press pointerup/pointerleave handlers only on component. If pointer moves outside during long press, timers may keep running.
suggestion: Add document-level pointerup listener during long press, remove when ends.

finding: Arrow functions created inline in template for pointerdown handlers. Defeats Lit's event listener cache.
suggestion: Create separate named methods for increment/decrement handlers.

finding: @query uses non-null assertion (!) for _panelEl which may be null when panel is conditionally rendered.
suggestion: Use without ! or handle null at usage sites.

finding: _handleKeydown uses shadowRoot.querySelector and activeElement instead of @query decorators.
suggestion: Use @query('.list') decorator.

finding: Page size options [10,25,50,100] hardcoded in template. Should be configurable for enterprise use.
suggestion: Add @property pageSizeOptions: number[] = [10, 25, 50, 100].

finding: updated() does not call super.updated(changedProperties). Missing super call.
suggestion: Add super.updated(changedProperties) as first line.

finding: Uses shadowRoot.querySelector for anchor slot instead of @query decorator.
suggestion: Use @query('slot[name="anchor"]').

finding: Uses shadowRoot.querySelector for body part and nested queries instead of @query.
suggestion: Use @query('[part="body"]').

finding: Arrow element uses empty string fallback instead of nothing sentinel.
suggestion: Use nothing instead of '' for cleaner DOM.

finding: updated() uses Map<string | symbol, unknown> instead of PropertyValues<this> for changedProperties.
suggestion: Change to PropertyValues<this> for type safety.

finding: Repeated shadowRoot.querySelector calls for popup and arrow parts instead of @query decorators.
suggestion: Use @query('[part="popup"]') and @query('[part="arrow"]').

finding: Arrow element uses empty string fallback instead of nothing.
suggestion: Use nothing from lit.

finding: updated() does not call super.updated(changedProps). Missing super call breaks lifecycle chains.
suggestion: Add super.updated(changedProps) as first line.

finding: updated() directly manipulates this.style.setProperty as side effect.
suggestion: Move CSS custom property update to willUpdate() or template.

finding: devWarn() called on every update cycle when label not set, not gated by changedProps check.
suggestion: Gate with changedProps.has('label') or warned-once flag.

finding: willUpdate() directly manipulates host element attributes via setAttribute/removeAttribute for ARIA sync.
suggestion: Consider using @property with reflect for role/aria-valuemin.

finding: connectedCallback sets static attributes (role, aria-valuemin). Legacy size migration only runs once on connect.
suggestion: Set static attributes in constructor or firstUpdated. Handle legacy size in willUpdate.

finding: updated() does not call super.updated(changedProperties).
suggestion: Add super.updated(changedProperties) for consistency.

finding: connectedCallback sets this.style.display = 'block' imperatively.
suggestion: Move display:block into adopted stylesheet CSS.

finding: AdoptedStylesheetsController instantiated with document reference at class field level. SSR-unsafe.
suggestion: Defer document reference to connectedCallback.

finding: formStateRestoreCallback does not handle null case. Type signature differs from other form components.
suggestion: Add | null to type: state: string | File | FormData | null.

finding: updated() does not call super.updated(changedProps). Missing super call.
suggestion: Add super.updated(changedProps) as first line.

finding: firstUpdated() does not call super.firstUpdated().
suggestion: Add super.firstUpdated() for future-proofing.

finding: Multiple inline arrow functions per star in template. New closures on each render for each star.
suggestion: Use event delegation with data-index attributes.

finding: String concatenation for class construction instead of classMap.
suggestion: Use classMap({ base: true, 'base--disabled': this.disabled }).

finding: Uses shadowRoot.querySelector for default slot instead of @query decorator.
suggestion: Use @query('slot:not([name])') decorator.

finding: Inline style="display:none;" on slot element instead of CSS class.
suggestion: Move display:none to styles file.

finding: open property declared as reflected @property but represents internal UI state (dropdown visibility).
suggestion: Use @state() for internal-only state, or document as supported public API.

finding: Uses shadowRoot.querySelector for default slot instead of @query.
suggestion: Use @query('slot:not([name])').

finding: Duplicate shadowRoot.querySelector for default slot in _handleKeydown.
suggestion: Use single @query decorator and reference in both methods.

finding: Uses document.activeElement which returns shadow host, not deeply focused element in nested shadow roots.
suggestion: Use shadowRoot.activeElement or recursive traversal.

finding: updated() uses Map<string | symbol, unknown> instead of PropertyValues<this>.
suggestion: Change to PropertyValues<this>.

finding: connectedCallback sets aria-hidden='true' but never removes it when loaded=true.
suggestion: Update aria-hidden in updated() based on loaded property.

finding: Returns html`` (empty template) instead of nothing sentinel when loaded.
suggestion: Replace with return nothing; for idiomatic Lit.

finding: requestAnimationFrame in firstUpdated() not cancelled in disconnectedCallback. Callback can run on detached DOM.
suggestion: Store rAF handle and cancel in disconnectedCallback.

finding: valueText property overrides built-in ariaValueText from HTMLElement. Could cause ARIA reflection conflicts.
suggestion: Rename to non-ARIA attribute name and forward to aria-valuetext on input.

finding: Uses shadowRoot.querySelector for menu slot instead of @query.
suggestion: Use @query('slot[name="menu"]').

finding: Uses document.activeElement for focus tracking. Wrong in nested shadow DOM.
suggestion: Use shadowRoot.activeElement or composedPath.

finding: _handleOutsideClick uses this.contains(target) which doesn't traverse shadow DOM boundaries.
suggestion: Use e.composedPath().includes(this) instead.

finding: requestAnimationFrame in connectedCallback not stored for cleanup. Callback can run on detached element.
suggestion: Store rAF handle and cancel in disconnectedCallback.

finding: willUpdate calls _setPosition which dispatches hx-reposition event. Side effect in willUpdate.
suggestion: Move event dispatch to updated().

finding: connectedCallback unconditionally sets aria-label before first render. Redundant if updated() also syncs it.
suggestion: Rely solely on updated() or firstUpdated() for initial sync.

finding: _getSteps uses querySelectorAll(':scope > hx-step') bypassing slot API.
suggestion: Use slot.assignedElements({ flatten: true }) for consistency.

finding: ariaLabel declared as @property with attribute 'aria-label' overrides built-in ariaLabel from HTMLElement.
suggestion: Remove explicit @property and rely on Lit's built-in ARIA reflection.

finding: Static _instanceCounter pattern differs from module-level counter used by other components. Inconsistency.
suggestion: Standardize on one pattern across all components.

finding: connectedCallback uses this.querySelector for slotted caption. May run before children are parsed in SSR/streaming.
suggestion: Rely solely on slotchange handler for detecting slotted content.

finding: willUpdate does not call super.willUpdate().
suggestion: Add super.willUpdate(changed) at start.

finding: Caption slot slotchange handler only registered when hasCaption is true. Chicken-and-egg problem for dynamic slot content.
suggestion: Always render caption slot (hidden) with slotchange handler attached.

finding: Uses document.activeElement to find focused tab. Fails in nested shadow root contexts.
suggestion: Use (this.getRootNode() as Document | ShadowRoot).activeElement.

finding: Uses shadowRoot.querySelector for slot elements instead of @query decorators.
suggestion: Use @query decorators for tab and panel slot references.

finding: MutationObserver observes attributes only, not childList. Won't detect child element reordering without slotchange.
suggestion: Add childList: true to MutationObserver options.

finding: updated() uses Map<PropertyKey, unknown> instead of PropertyValues<this>.
suggestion: Change to PropertyValues<this> for type safety.

finding: Reaches into child shadow DOM via targetTab.shadowRoot?.querySelector('button'). Tight coupling.
suggestion: Add public focus() method to hx-tab that delegates to internal button.

finding: Event handlers are regular methods inconsistent with arrow function pattern used elsewhere.
suggestion: Convert to arrow function properties for consistency.

finding: _safeTag getter creates new Set on every access during render.
suggestion: Move to static class field or module-level constant.

finding: render() reads this.textContent for titleText. Not tracked by Lit reactivity. Slotted content changes won't update title.
suggestion: Use @slotchange handler to capture slot text into @state property.

finding: Error div with role='alert' always rendered even without error. Screen readers may announce empty live region.
suggestion: Conditionally render error container only when hasError is true.

finding: Direct DOM manipulation of textarea style.height in updated() for auto-grow. State lost on disconnect/reconnect.
suggestion: Guard with isConnected check to avoid operating on detached DOM.

finding: Uses shadowRoot.querySelector for status announcer instead of @query.
suggestion: Use @query('[role="status"]') decorator.

finding: High-contrast token overrides hardcoded in component source. Maintenance burden.
suggestion: Export from @helixui/tokens for single source of truth.

finding: Document click listener added in connectedCallback for outside-click detection. Arrow function reference is stable so duplicates prevented, but no explicit guard.
suggestion: Pattern is safe due to stable reference. Consider isConnected guard in handler for extra safety.

finding: Type assertion (changed as Map<PropertyKey, unknown>).has('_open') used for @state property check.
suggestion: Use changedProperties.has('_open' as keyof this) for cleaner typing.

finding: Fallback setTimeout in _emitHide() not tracked or cleared in disconnectedCallback. Timer can fire after component removal.
suggestion: Track setTimeout in class property and clear in disconnectedCallback.

finding: @query uses ! non-null assertion with nullable type. Misleading since type includes null.
suggestion: Remove ! assertion.

finding: updated() uses Map<PropertyKey, unknown> instead of PropertyValues<this>.
suggestion: Use PropertyValues<this> for type safety.

finding: _updateValidity uses shadowRoot.querySelector instead of @query for button anchor element.
suggestion: Use @query('[part="button"]') decorator.

finding: @query uses ! non-null assertion with nullable type.
suggestion: Remove ! assertion.

finding: document.createElement('span') appended to light DOM in firstUpdated. Mutates host's light DOM from within component. Fragile across SSR hydration.
suggestion: Use different ARIA pattern or ensure light DOM element properly managed across reconnection.

finding: Multiple @query decorators use ! non-null assertion with nullable types.
suggestion: Remove ! assertions from @query decorators.

finding: _handleTriggerMouseleave uses document.activeElement. Wrong in nested shadow DOMs.
suggestion: Use (this.getRootNode() as Document | ShadowRoot).activeElement.

finding: Uses shadowRoot.querySelector for default slot instead of @query.
suggestion: Use @query('slot:not([name])') decorator.

finding: Uses shadowRoot.querySelector for mobile toggle button instead of @query.
suggestion: Use @query('[part="mobile-toggle"]') decorator.

finding: Uses document.activeElement for focus tracking. Incorrect in nested shadow DOM.
suggestion: Use (this.getRootNode() as Document | ShadowRoot).activeElement.

finding: _collectVisibleItems recursively traverses children on every keydown. Performance concern for large trees.
suggestion: Cache visible items, invalidate on slotchange or expand/collapse.

finding: tokenStyles included in styles array but component doesn't use any design tokens. Unnecessary overhead.
suggestion: Remove tokenStyles from styles array.
